concerns.text: The plan implements a *single‑group pre/post* design ("within‑subject pre/post experimental pipeline") and evaluates success solely by testing whether the mean change differs from zero (p < 0.05 and d ≥ 0.2). Because the intervention variable (digital decluttering) is constant for all participants and not modeled independently (e.g., no control group or compliance‑as‑predictor analysis), the validation target (post‑pre change) is not independent of the predictor. This makes any claim that the intervention *caused* the observed change circular and vulnerable to confounds such as practice effects, regression to the mean, or temporal trends.
